title: Voodoo Horror? How would everyone feel if it was with a Black protagonist and showed the good and bad of voodoo?

commenti.body:
In the spirit of "two wrongs don't make a right", I don't see how there can be a positive side to Voodoo.


In so many words, you are talking about appealing to heathen gods (i.e. demons) to curse your enemies, or make them slaves to your will.


Yes, there are protective spells, but either way those demons own your soul.


The type of film you suggest could be good if it was ultimately a monkey's paw story, where the protagonist enters into the world of Voodoo to try and do something good, but ultimately damns himself or his loved ones.


It would certainly be a cinematographers wet dream to explore the imagery, costumes, etc while doing a deep dive into historical Haitian culture.


I would love to see a witch doctor shrink someone's head (like in Beetlejuice) in a serious context.


You could even justify a John Wick style fight scene with a bunch of somnambulists protecting a powerful sorcerer.


It has potential!

Why do you say theres no positive side of voodoo? 

Voodoo to a lot (example, the oppressed during slavery) was about empowering yourself and giving yourself something to believe in. I definitely think there are positive aspects and traditions in voodoo along with negative ones too.

Any case where a person is channeling otherworldly power for their own ends is a negative case.


Leaving aside that magic isn't actually real, in the tradition of virtually every major religion, a person is merely an instrument, they do not have any inherent power, and cannot use that power unless it is at the express wish of the deity in question.


And any deity that grants powers like mind control is *probably* not trustworthy.


Any person that willingly uses such power, regardless of their circumstances, is evil.
So would hinduism be evil to you?

I’m surprised you’re being pushed back on this I think it’s just a scary word that scares people

Voodoo is incredibly complicated and was used for tons of harmless and positive rituals over the years
